summary: All seven findings verified as real. RD-R1 (major) fixed: the overview bar hides the name word 'Disaster Mapping' visually at 1024-1279 px (logo and accessible name stay), so the centre view pill no longer covers the Fires | Floods switch; a Playwright check script measures the bar at any widths (36 pages, all pass) and a unit test guards the rule. RD-R2 fixed in this container (fixture re-made, Grand River re-prepared, the other seven floods' stored app notes rewritten offline; data/ holds no 'Fire-3d') and the README gives the exact re-prepare commands; the automatic serving-time heal lives in api/floods.py (backend-flood-time-3d, their R11) and is described for them. RD-R3 fixed in part: README pictures re-shot with the new name, the timeline and pass routes, the flood time history and 3D products, the flood_3d.py script and credits added; the brief-6 playback and 3D-view wording waits for web-flood-playback and web-forensic-flood-3d, which are not built yet (left to final-check with the exact labels to add). RD-R4, R5, R6, R7 fixed: CONTRACT dimming paragraph, README troubleshooting row, the switch drawn as the app's pill switch without aria-checked, and the demo-flood phone title on two lines.
